Una foto por prenda y una ficha. El arma: One photo per garment and a record. The wardrobe sorts itself by colour or by type, tells you what you wear and suggests outfits you can see on yourself. Try the demo with 10 garments and watch the video.
Armario: tu ropa, fichada y colgada en b: Wardrobe: your clothes, catalogued and hung on shelves
Diez prendas para colocar por color o po: Ten garments to arrange by colour or by type, and the real wardrobe on video. All on your phone.
Your clothes, catalogued and hung on shelves.
Una foto de cada prenda y una ficha: tip: A photo of each garment and a record: type, brand, size, colour. With that, the whole wardrobe sorts itself by shade or by type, tells you what you wear and what you don't, and suggests outfits you can see on yourself. All on your phone, and the photos never leave it.
Por color: neutros de claro a oscuro, de: By colour: neutrals from light to dark, then by hue.
Arriba y abajo: lo que va cerca de la ca: Top and bottom: what goes near the face comes first.
Polo verde en percha: Green polo shirt on a hanger
En la aplicación, además, cada prenda ti: In the app, each garment also has its record and its colour and cut verdict; and the shelves combine with filters, brand and search.
Es mi ropa: 82 prendas fichadas. El víde: It's my clothes: 82 garments catalogued. The video shows the cards, the hanger rail, the shelves by type and by colour, and three outfits on me, simulated with AI.

Tarjetas → perchas → baldas por tipo → b: Cards → hangers → shelves by type → shelves by colour → on me.
Tres pasos, y el trabajo pesado lo hace: Three steps, and the phone does the heavy lifting.
Se recorta sola, se propone el tipo y el: It crops itself, type and colour are suggested, and a record is kept with brand, size and fabric if they can be read on the label.
Perchas, tarjetas o tabla. Baldas por co: Hangers, cards or table. Shelves by colour, type, brand or by what suits you best. Filters and search on top.
Con tu tono de piel y tu silueta, cada p: With your skin tone and your silhouette, each garment gets a colour and cut verdict, and outfits come out that you can see on yourself.
Lo que es y lo que no: What it is and what it isn't
Es la aplicación que uso cada día con mi: It's the app I use every day with my own clothes. The first public version will be for iPhone.
Las fotos y las fichas viven en tu dispo: Photos and records live on your device. Export and import are up to you, with no account and no server.
Los conjuntos puestos son simulaciones p: The outfits shown on me are simulations for comparison. Exact size and drape are checked when you get dressed.
Los veredictos de color y corte parten d: The colour and cut verdicts come from an analysis made by a professional. The app applies it to each garment; it doesn't replace it.
¿Quieres estar en la primera versión?: Want to be in the first version?
Escríbeme y te aviso cuando salga para i: Write to me and I'll let you know when it's out for iPhone. If you have a similar idea for another collection, tell me: the same base works for anything that can be photographed and sorted.
